patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,132 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.current_frame = 1
+        self.frame_rolls = []  # Rolls in the current frame
+        self.frames = []  # Completed frames
+        self.game_over = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.game_over:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+        
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        
+        # Check if we're in the 10th frame
+        if self.current_frame == 10:
+            return self._roll_tenth_frame(pins)
+        else:
+            return self._roll_regular_frame(pins)
+
+    def _roll_regular_frame(self, pins):
+        self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # First roll of frame
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+            if pins == 10:  # Strike
+                self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+                self.current_frame += 1
+        # Second roll of frame
+        else:  # len(self.frame_rolls) == 2
+            if self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1] > 10 and self.frame_rolls[0] != 10:
+                raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            
+            self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+            self.frame_rolls = []
+            self.current_frame += 1
+
+    def _roll_tenth_frame(self, pins):
+        self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # Handle the special rules for the 10th frame
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+            # First ball - no restrictions except normal ones already checked
+            pass
+        elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+            # Second ball
+            # If first was a strike, second can be anything up to 10
+            # If first wasn't a strike, sum can't exceed 10
+            if self.frame_rolls[0] != 10 and self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1] > 10:
+                raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:
+            # Third ball - only allowed in special cases
+            # If we have 3 rolls, it must be because of a strike or spare
+            if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10:  # First roll was a strike
+                # Second roll could be anything, third roll has restrictions based on second
+                if self.frame_rolls[1] != 10 and self.frame_rolls[1] + self.frame_rolls[2] > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            elif self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1] == 10:  # First two rolls were a spare
+                # Third roll is just a bonus, no restrictions beyond normal ones
+                pass
+            else:
+                # We shouldn't have a third roll if first two weren't strike or spare
+                raise ValueError("Should not be able to roll after game is over")
+            
+            # Game is over after third roll in 10th frame
+            self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+            self.game_over = True
+            return
+        
+        # Check if frame is complete (and it's not the third roll case)
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+            # If it's not a strike or spare, game is over
+            if self.frame_rolls[0] != 10 and self.frame_rolls[0] + self.frame_rolls[1] != 10:
+                self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+                self.game_over = True
+            # If it's a strike or spare, we need more rolls (handled above)
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.game_over and (len(self.frames) < 10 or (len(self.frames) == 10 and len(self.frame_rolls) > 0)):
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        if len(self.frames) < 10:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        # Score first 9 frames
+        for frame_num in range(9):
+            if frame_num >= len(self.frames):
+                raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+                
+            frame = self.frames[frame_num]
+            
+            if len(frame) == 1:  # Strike
+                total_score += 10
+                # Add next two rolls
+                if frame_num + 1 < len(self.frames):
+                    next_frame = self.frames[frame_num + 1]
+                    if len(next_frame) >= 1:
+                        total_score += next_frame[0]
+                    if len(next_frame) >= 2:
+                        total_score += next_frame[1]
+                    elif len(next_frame) == 1 and frame_num + 2 < len(self.frames):  # Next frame was also a strike
+                        if len(self.frames[frame_num + 2]) >= 1:
+                            total_score += self.frames[frame_num + 2][0]
+            elif len(frame) == 2:
+                frame_score = frame[0] + frame[1]
+                if frame_score == 10:  # Spare
+                    total_score += 10
+                    # Add next roll
+                    if frame_num + 1 < len(self.frames):
+                        if len(self.frames[frame_num + 1]) >= 1:
+                            total_score += self.frames[frame_num + 1][0]
+                else:  # Open frame
+                    total_score += frame_score
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("Invalid frame")
+        
+        # Score 10th frame
+        if len(self.frames) < 10:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+            
+        tenth_frame = self.frames[9]
+        total_score += sum(tenth_frame)
+        
+        return total_score
